provenance.note: Repository-owned current-live readiness, profile, geometry, and diagnostic observation. This is a distinct artifact schema, not the legacy dom-profiles trace, timing, boundary, or resource-hash schema. Values are run-specific and reruns may expose upstream changes.
provenance.runtimeFailurePolicy: Main navigation must return 200; readiness, required selector/input contracts, uncaught page errors, and observed main-thread WebGL context-loss events are fatal. Console messages, ancillary request failures, and HTTP resource errors remain recorded diagnostics.

subtitle.text: AI driven speed. Expert curation.We mobilize verified crews to protect your schedule and your bottom line in high-consequence environments.

description.text: One call triggers mobilization. Your requirements: craft, count, and start date route directly to our verified crews. No hand-offs. No escalations. Just boots on the ground in minutes.

Our team handles all screening and verification before dispatch. Compliance, background, certifications, and fitness-for-duty — we enforce a zero-fail model to guarantee every worker clears the gate on Day 1.

We don't just provide available workers. We deploy proven crews. By filtering for past performance, role fit, and reliability, we deliver teams engineered for endurance — ensuring your project stays fully manned from first break to completion.

We manage the "last mile" of mobilization. Every crew arrives site-ready with finalized reporting details. With real-time arrival monitoring and active coordination, we ensure your shift starts on time, even when field conditions shift.
